title: Schema Stitching Configuration
description: JSON Schema for configuring a GraphQL schema stitching gateway, defining subschemas, type merging, and field delegation.

subschemas.description: Array of subschemas to stitch together into a unified gateway schema.

typeDefs.description: Additional GraphQL type definitions to extend the stitched schema with extra fields or types.

resolvers.description: Additional resolver functions for types and fields added via typeDefs.

mergeTypes.description: Whether to automatically merge types with the same name across subschemas.

schema.description: The GraphQL schema SDL string or reference to a remote schema.

url.description: URL of the remote GraphQL service endpoint.

batch.description: Whether to batch queries to this subschema using DataLoader-style batching.

merge.description: Type merging configuration for this subschema.

transforms.description: Schema transforms to apply to this subschema before stitching.

executor.description: Custom executor function name for this subschema.

selectionSet.description: GraphQL selection set for fetching the key fields required to merge this type.

fieldName.description: The query field name used to fetch a single merged type by key.

argsFromKeys.description: Function expression mapping key values to query arguments.

key.description: Function expression extracting the merge key from a type object.

dataLoaderOptions.description: DataLoader configuration for batched type merging.

maxBatchSize.description: Maximum number of keys per batch request.

SchemaTransform.description: A schema transformation to apply to a subschema.

type.description: The type of transformation to apply.

config.description: Configuration specific to the transform type.

StitchingDirectivesConfig.description: Configuration for stitching directives SDL approach.

keyDirective.description: Name of the directive used to specify merge keys.

mergeDirective.description: Name of the directive used to configure type merging.

computedDirective.description: Name of the directive used to specify computed fields.
